### SpecDiagram

```ts
const SpecDiagram: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "children"> &
    object &
    RefAttributes<HTMLElement>
>;
```

A manual-style parts diagram: tags drawn on the art and a legend that names each
part. The legend is the accessible text; tags are decorative.

## Functions

### SpecPrintFilter()

```ts
function SpecPrintFilter(__namedParameters): Element;
```

The `#caps-print` SVG filter, rendered once per page. It turns 1-bit art (dark
ink on light paper) into the theme's ink on a transparent ground, with a second
ink printed slightly off register underneath, like a two-drum risograph. Art
opts in through the theme's `--caps-print-filter`; the inks come from
`--caps-print-ink` and `--caps-print-offset`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter           | Type                                            |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `__namedParameters` | [`SpecPrintFilterProps`](#specprintfilterprops) |

#### Returns

`Element`
